title: Avengers: Doctor Doom premieres and pre‑sale starts in September
seoTitle: Avengers: Doctor Doom premieres, pre‑sale starts Sep
subtitle: Everything known about the advance ticket sale, cast, direction and runtime
excerpt: Disney announced the start date for advance ticket sales for Avengers: Doctor Doom, which hits theaters on December 17, featuring a large ensemble cast and more.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
With the official advance‑ticket‑sale date announced, fans are scrambling to secure seats for the opening shows of Avengers: Doctor Doom, which premieres in theaters on December 17.

Advance‑sale date and ticket format

Tickets will be available starting September 28 at 00:01 BRT, exclusively for screenings in Infinity Vision‑equipped auditoriums. Purchases will be made through the Ingresso.com website and apps. Disney has yet to announce the advance‑sale opening date for traditional‑circuit theaters.

Cast and returning characters

Villain Victor Von Doom, played by Robert Downey Jr., leads the conflict. The film gathers a sprawling cast, including Ryan Reynolds (Deadpool), Hugh Jackman (Wolverine), Patrick Stewart (Professor X), Ian McKellen (Magneto), Kelsey Grammer (Beast) and Rebecca Romijn (Mystique). Returning also are Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Paul Rudd, Winston Duke, Letitia Wright, Simu Liu, Danny Ramirez, the new Fantastic Four, almost the entire Thunderbolts ensemble and Tenoch Huerta as Namor.

Direction and screenplay

The movie is directed by brothers Anthony and Joe Russo, who helmed Avengers: Endgame. The script was written by Michael Waldron, creator of Loki, and Stephen McFeely, who worked on Agent Carter.

Runtime and comparison with other films

Avengers: Doctor Doom runs approximately two hours and forty‑five minutes, according to ticket‑sale sites. It is the second‑longest major MCU crossover, trailing only Avengers: Endgame, which exceeds three hours.

Mysteries surrounding Hulk's presence

Directors Anthony and Joe Russo have hinted at uncertainty regarding Bruce Banner (the Hulk) appearing in the film. In additional scenes from Endgame Encore, Doom confronts Banner, but the brothers say they will neither confirm nor deny the character’s involvement, suggesting he could play a significant role in the story.

Information sourced from Ingresso.com, Omelete, AdoroCinema.
